Sunnah List.Sunnah: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Your smile for your brother is a charity." (Ref: Tirmidhi 1956)
"The best among you are those who have the best manners." (Ref: Bukhari 3559)
"Make things easy, not difficult; give glad tidings, not discouragement." (Ref: Bukhari 69)
"He who does not thank people, does not thank Allah." (Ref: Tirmidhi 1954)
"True strength is in self-control, not overpowering others." (Ref: Bukhari 6114)
"Exchange gifts, as that will lead to increasing your love to one another." (Ref: Bukhari 2567)
"The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small." (Ref: Bukhari 6465)
"You truly believe when you love for your brother what you love for yourself." (Ref: Bukhari 13)
"Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captive." (Ref: Bukhari 5649)
"The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it." (Ref: Bukhari 5027)
"Shake hands—it removes hatred and strengthens brotherhood." (Ref: Muwatta Malik 1746)
"Say Salam to those you know and those you don't." (Ref: Bukhari 6236)
"Use the miswak, for it cleanses the mouth and pleases the Lord." (Ref: Bukhari 887)
"Eat with your right hand and say Bismillah." (Ref: Bukhari 5376)
"Do not waste water, even if by a flowing river." (Ref: Ibn Majah 425)
"Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or oppressed." (Ref: Bukhari 2444)
"Speak good; if you cannot then remain silent." (Ref: Bukhari 6018)
A man asked the Prophet ﷺ for advice. He said: "Do not get angry." (Ref: Bukhari 6116)
"Secure your means; tie your camel then trust in Allah." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2517)
"Visit the sick—it softens the heart and earns Allah’s mercy." (Ref: Muslim 2199)
"Cover your mouth when yawning, as it is from Shaytan." (Ref: Bukhari 6226)
The Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not lie, even if you are joking." (Ref: Tirmidhi 1995)
"Supplicate sincerely and believe it will be answered." (Ref: Tirmidhi 3479)
"Recite Ayat al-Kursi before sleeping for Allah’s protection." (Ref: Bukhari 2311)
The Prophet ﷺ said: "Sleep on your right side for blessings." (Ref: Bukhari 6312)
"The Prophet ﷺ sought Allah’s forgiveness over 70 times daily." (Ref: Bukhari 6307)
"The Prophet ﷺ urged kindness to neighbors." (Ref: Muslim 2625)
"Give charity, even if it is half a date. Charity protects from the Hellfire." (Ref: Bukhari 1410)
"Gentleness brings blessings; harshness removes them." (Ref: Muslim 2594)
"Say Salam before speaking—it's the right of a Muslim." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2699)
"Visit graves—they remind you of the Hereafter." (Ref: Muslim 976)
"The Prophet ﷺ avoided eating while reclining, as it's a sign of pride." (Ref: Bukhari 5398)
"Two rak'ahs before Fajr are better than the world and all in it." (Ref: Bukhari 1116)
"After sneezing, say 'Alhamdulillah'—a praised Sunnah." (Ref: Bukhari 6224)
"Avoid suspicion, for it is the worst of false tales." (Ref: Bukhari 6066)
"Use the right hand for eating and drinking." (Ref: Muslim 2020)
"Say 'Bismillah' before entering the home." (Ref: Muslim 2018)
"The Prophet ﷺ encouraged grooming of hair and appearing neat." (Ref: Abu Dawood 4163)
"He is not of us who shows no mercy to children." (Ref: Bukhari 5997)
"Respecting elders shows reverence for Allah." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2022)
"Lower your gaze—it purifies the heart and guards modesty." (Ref: Muslim 2159)
"No one with pride equal to a mustard seed enters Paradise." (Ref: Muslim 91)
"Say Salam when entering your home; it brings blessings." (Ref: Nur 24:61)
"Make dua for others in their absence, and angels will pray the same for you." (Ref: Muslim 2732)
"Do not interrupt others while they speak." (Ref: Bukhari 2690)
"Eat from what is nearest to you and observe table manners." (Ref: Muslim 2022)
"Walk humbly—the believers are those who walk gently." (Ref: Furqan 25:63)
"Avoid backbiting—it's like eating your dead brother's flesh." (Ref: Hujurat 49:12)
"Be honest in trade—the truthful will be with the prophets." (Ref: Bukhari 2076)
"Start with the right when putting on shoes." (Ref: Bukhari 168)
"Show gratitude for even small favors." (Ref: Tirmidhi 1954)
"The Prophet ﷺ visited the poor and sat among them." (Ref: Ibn Majah 4129)
"Say 'La ilaha illallah' often—it renews faith." (Ref: Ahmad 8497)
"Do not belittle any good deed, even a smile." (Ref: Muslim 2626)
"Maintain family ties, even with those who cut you off." (Ref: Bukhari 5988)
"Begin tasks with Bismillah—it brings blessings." (Ref: Ibn Majah 3264)
"Pray Tahajjud—it draws you nearer to Allah." (Ref: Muslim 1163)
"Say 'Astaghfirullah' often—it opens doors of mercy." (Ref: Bukhari 6307)
"Sit where you find space, not by status." (Ref: Abu Dawood 482)
"Whenever you are wronged, forgive—it elevates you." (Ref: Bukhari 5678)
"Feed your servant from what you eat and clothe them as yourself." (Ref: Muslim 1661)
"Speak gently, even when correcting others." (Ref: Bukhari 6030)
"Be punctual with salah—it is the pillar of Islam." (Ref: Bukhari 553)
"Giving water is among the best forms of charity in Islam." (Ref: Abu Dawood 1670)
"Do not curse time, for Allah controls it." (Ref: Bukhari 4826)
"Say Salam when leaving, as when entering." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2706)
"The Prophet ﷺ encouraged going to bed in a state of wudu (ablution)." (Ref: Bukhari 247)
"Saying 'Bismillah' before undressing serves as a shield from jinn." (Ref: Tirmidhi 606)
"Reconciling people is more virtuous than prayer, fasting, and charity." (Ref: Abu Dawood 4919)
"Whoever builds a masjid, Allah will build for him a house in Jannah." (Ref: Muslim 533)
"Remember death often—it destroys worldly desires." (Ref: Tirmidhi 2307)
"Be just—even if it is against yourself or those closest to you." (Ref: An-Nisa 4:135)
